messages.subject: the incomplete figure
parts:
Hello all,

I use the code below to draw a figure:
plot1 <- ggplot() + 
    geom_point(data=dataset1,aes(x,y)) + 
    geom_point(data=dataset2,aes(x,y))+
    xlab("x-axis") + ylab("y-axis")

The dataset1 and dataset2 include continuous data from 2006 to 2010, but why the figure just shows 2006-2007 in dataset1, and all years in dataset2? Why the other years in dataset1 are missing? I can't find out the problem. When plotting figure for dataset1 alone, it shows the correct figure. How to solve the problem? Thanks very much for your help.
